name: State Scientific Research Institute of Organic Chemistry and Technology
aliases: STATE SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ORGANIC CHEMISTRY AND TECHNOLOGY
State Scientific Research Institute for Organic Chemistry and Technology
Федеральное государственное унитарное предприятие «Государственный научно-исследовательский институт органической химии и технологии»
supervisors: Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation

evidence.summary: The US Commerce Department found reasonable cause to believe that the State Scientific Research Institute of Organic Chemistry and Technology (GosNIIOKhT) is a Russian Ministry of Defense facility associated with the Russian chemical weapons program, and listed it in August 2020; OFAC also lists it, under its weapons-of-mass-destruction proliferators programme.
It belongs to the Russian Ministry of Defence, in the US Commerce Department’s finding.
